test_pybind11_methods_and_attributes: test pybind11 bound C++ methods and attributes including overloaded functions and value properties
test_pybind11_copy_method: test that copied pybind11 bound methods work correctly in Python 3
test_pybind11_properties: test pybind11 readonly, readwrite, writeonly, and impossible property bindings on C++ classes
test_pybind11_static_properties: test pybind11 static property bindings including readonly, readwrite, and writeonly variants
test_pybind11_dynamic_attributes: test pybind11 dynamic attribute support including __dict__ access and cyclic garbage collection
